_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Level 1 and Level 2 labels that carry a topology
decision or a ruling. Hand-curated — these cannot be derived from a tree with no
deployed containers — but written ONCE and substituted everywhere by
render-c4-page.mjs, so one ruling updates every instance.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. On 12 Aug 2026 ruling G185 was applied to the C4 page by
hand. Level 1's data-plane label was corrected and Level 2's twin was left
standing; the control database was described four ways on one page, one of them
implying N writers against the ruling's one. Four of an adversarial pass's seven
blockers were a hand-typed label disagreeing with another hand-typed label about
the same object. Levels 3-4 have check-c4-freshness.mjs and have never drifted;
Levels 1-2 had nothing.
RULES.
- Every entry needs a `status` from the page legend: BUILT | PARTLY |
DESIGNED | UNDECIDED | DROPPED | BLOCKED. A container with no status is how
an unbuilt thing gets read as live.
- `ruling` names the G row that decided it, or null. render-c4-page.mjs
verifies every named ruling exists in docs/HANDOFF.md §3 and fails if it
does not — a badge citing a ruling nobody took is worse than no badge.
- Say UNDECIDED out loud. It is a status, not an omission.
NOT IN SCOPE. Prose captions stay in the template: forcing an argument into a
data file makes it read worse and buys nothing, because a paragraph is not
repeated in six places. This file is for the labels that ARE.
PREDICATES — G4419, 5 Oct 2026. An entry may carry a `predicate`, evaluated over the
tree by c4-verify.mjs (servedTiers · files · controlTables · dataTables · screens · all).
render-c4-page.mjs and check-c4-freshness.mjs both REFUSE an entry whose `status`
disagrees with its predicate, and `{{status.KEY}}` / `{{badge.KEY}}` / `{{evidence.KEY}}`
print the verified status, its badge class and the predicate's own evidence — so a
Level 2 badge is the same entry the checker tested. Until this date every badge on
the page was typed, and four of them said DESIGNED over containers that were serving.
CORRECTED 5 Oct 2026 RATHER THAN REWRITTEN. Texts below that went false while the
tree moved under them keep their old sentence in `wasUntil5Oct2026`, which the page
renders in its history block.
